integrity: The argument gives analytic mixed factorial-moment convergence with an overlap-component bound. Reproducible finite exact enumeration and independent partial-assignment checks are corroborative, not proof of a limit. Historical priority beyond the inspected source material remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite signed displacements and fixed distance thresholds; weak point-process convergence only. Previously known single-succession and Manhattan marginal conclusions are not claimed as new. No claim of a quantitative uniform bound for offsets growing with sample size.
title: A spatially marked Poisson field of microscopic pairs in uniform permutation plots
